fields.System.Title: RET-501 — Return rate by product
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a product manager, I want to see which products come back most often, so that the
cause upstream can be fixed rather than the returns endlessly processed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get returns as a percentage of units shipped, per product.
  • - Given the report, then products with too few shipments to be meaningful are excluded.
  • - Given a high-rate product, then I can see the breakdown by return reason.
  • - Given the report, then it is built from a daily read model.
  • - Given a product whose dominant reason is "not as described", then it is highlighted as
  • a likely product data problem rather than a warehouse problem.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, outbound |
| Tables | return rate projection |
| Risks | Live aggregate query degrading ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
